outline.chapter_title: Why Large Language Models Require New Finetuning Techniques
outline.description:
"How billions‐parameter models currently demand hundreds of GBs when fully finetuned.
What motivates shifting precision down while preserving accuracy.
Why existing post‑training quantisation fails during backpropagation.
The goal set out in this work – efficient finite precision finetuning that operates on consumer GPUs."
subtopics: "GPU memory barrier (~780 GB) faced by fully finetuned models"
"Need for adaptive techniques that retain learnability"
